text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at the sporting goods store...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I would like some assistance,
please.
Could I get these, these, and
those as well?

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text:
Y-you want all of them?! I appreciate
the
patronage, but are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. They are all wonderful
shoes that
exude the very souls of their
makers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You there, were you not also drawn here
by these
captivating shoes?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am, in fact, referring to you! Now
tell me,
do you not have the urge to own
every pair of
these beauties?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, you are absolutely right!
Groove
reprimanded me the other day
for the very same
reason.
choice_data_list: 寮の靴箱に入らないんじゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... While it pains me to do so, I
must
restrain myself and only buy a
single pair of
shoes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
While I still have you here, what kind of
shoes do
you think would be the best?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I concur. It is not every day I buy
new shoes,
and getting ones that enable
me to run faster
would be a true delight.
choice_data_list: 軽くて速く走れそうなシューズ
重いけど鍛えられそうなシューズ

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Let us search for the lightest
shoes in
this store!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And once I have them purchased, I
challenge you
to a race! Hehe, I believe
this will make for a
lovely memory. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now that is quite a shame. I thought it
would be
good fun...
choice_data_list: いや、ウマ娘と競走はちょっと……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! These shoes look quite light indeed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she's paid for the shoes, Fine
Motion
puts them on and runs off in a
flash.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How very intriguing. While heavy shoes
may be
difficult to run in, I suppose they
would be good
training aids.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Those shoes over there might fit the bill
nicely.
Look, they're so big and heavy,
simply walking in
them would be great
fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have never worn such
cumbersome shoes
before, and first-time
experiences are always so
refreshing and
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That settles it. Excuse me! I would like
those
shoes, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After purchasing her new shoes, Fine
Motion puts
them on and walks off. Her
gait may be awkward,
but her smile
shines far brighter.
